purpose: Frozen exploratory matched-kernel accuracy follow-up. Selected from validation-only pilot: longer training improved validation AUROC, while augmentation lowered it. The official test split was previously inspected by the original study, so this is explicitly exploratory rather than fresh confirmation.
selection: Configuration selected on three-seed validation AUROC only: fidelity 0.99238 versus dot 0.99117. No test outcomes selected epochs, architecture or optimizer.
primary_comparison: Fidelity minus matched low-dimensional dot, accuracy and AUROC across five training seeds.
interpretation: Longer training is an optimization improvement, not a novel quantum algorithm. Product fidelity remains an analytical classical formula during training/inference.
